input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 addresses only loss of access, Deliverable delivery and refunds. Nothing obliges Vendor to provide transition assistance (10.1 merely assumes "any agreed transition period" with no entitlement or pricing) or to return or export Customer Data in a usable format, and no deletion certification exists. Section 16.5 covers only Confidential Information return and defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15 — Section 11 does not exist in the document and Section 15 contains only processing-purpose and privacy-compliance duties. The rule's fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day data export) is therefore not met anywhere, so we insert a new 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (carve-outs for routine backups and legal retention mirroring 16.5).

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to transition assistance or to get our Customer Data back on exit. This follows our position of up to six months' assistance at your then-current rates, machine-readable data return within thirty days, and certified deletion afterwards; we can discuss a shorter assistance period if needed.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, machine-readable Customer Data return within 30 days, and certified deletion.
